scripts.build: npm run registry && npm run sitemap && npm run build -w @uicean/docs
scripts.build:lib: npm run build -w uicean && npm run build -w uicean-blocks
scripts.build:all: npm run build:lib && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w uicean && npm run typecheck -w uicean-blocks && npm run typecheck -w @uicean/docs
scripts.test: npm run test -w uicean && npm run test -w uicean-blocks
